analysis.inconclusive_rule: If any primary comparison is undefined because a pressure target is unreachable or an analysis stratum is absent, report the criterion as inconclusive; do not impute, replace the endpoint, or tune the grid.
analysis.policy_seed_scope: Policy seeds, if sampled REINFORCE is added, measure optimizer variability and never replace reward-training seeds.
primary_contrasts: primary selector minus each fixed-pressure baseline
analysis.primary_unit: independently trained reward checkpoint crossed with dataset
analysis.success_criterion: The primary selector has lower mean held-out decision regret than every fixed-pressure baseline and best-of-N, and its interval excludes zero for the contrast with the strongest non-oracle baseline.
analysis.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap resampling reward-training seed and evaluation document; external controls reported separately

baselines.always_optimize: largest jointly reachable frozen pressure target, defined without outcomes
baselines.human_oracle: evaluation-only ceiling choosing the pressure with greatest held-out human quality; never available to a decision method

claim_boundary: The study concerns pressure selection for fixed candidate-pool MT policies. It does not establish safety for generative RL or prove that a removed DA slice contains incorrect individual annotations.

confirmation_data.dataset_selection_failure_rule: If no eligible fresh pool exists, stop prospective confirmation and report the feasibility failure; do not relabel a viewed pool as fresh.
eligibility: publicly releasable source and candidate text
human scores available at candidate level but unopened at selection time
document identifiers sufficient for disjoint calibration and evaluation
enough machine systems for disjoint train-system and heldout-system sets
rectangular candidate coverage after prespecified non-machine exclusions
no dataset or direction listed in excluded_previously_examined_pools

excluded_previously_examined_pools.wmt23_zh_en_mqm: Used in the completed prospective sign-screen test
excluded_previously_examined_pools.wmt24_ja_zh_mqm: Used in the completed prospective sign-screen test
excluded_previously_examined_pools.wmt25_released_mqm_candidate_pools: Used in reward-model and best-of-N development
excluded_previously_examined_pools.wmt26_zh_ja_cesa: Used in reward-model and bandit development

confirmation_data.manifest_freeze_rule: Create and hash exact dataset revision, documents, segments, candidate systems, reward checkpoints, and splits using metadata and candidate coverage only, before reading any human score.
outcome_access_order: compute label-free audits and all policy trajectories
validate and hash every policy artifact
open calibration human labels and freeze pressure decisions
open evaluation human labels exactly once

split.calibration_sampling: deterministic hash-ranked document sample stratified by declared domain; one deterministic hash-ranked eligible segment per selected document
split.evaluation: all eligible segments in all remaining documents
split.system_split: deterministic hash-ranked balanced split fixed in the manifest; policy receives source-candidate text and no system identity

development_evidence.classification: All existing outcomes are development evidence and may motivate this design, but none may enter the future confirmation endpoint.
development_evidence.observed_design_fact: The completed sign screen discarded beneficial low-pressure updates; the new decision therefore selects pressure rather than only optimize/keep.

label_free_audits.analysis_rule: Report associations with oracle safe pressure with leave-one-dataset-out estimates; do not promote a feature to a confirmation decision after evaluation outcomes are opened.

features.between_system_separation: fraction of residual standardized reward variance attributable to system
features.initial_concentration_rate: first-order normalized-KL change under the frozen update
features.initial_gradient_norm: Euclidean norm of the exact reward gradient
features.reward_seed_disagreement: mean within-source variance of standardized scores across independent reward seeds in the same training condition
features.reward_tail_gap: mean within-source gap between the largest and second-largest reward
features.top_system_preference_margin: largest system mean standardized reward minus the grand mean

label_free_audits.role: Secondary predictors and mechanism diagnostics. They do not change the primary pressure decision in protocol version 1.0.

next_freeze: An outcome-blind data audit must produce the exact confirmation manifest and hash this protocol before any fresh candidate human score is read.

outcomes.human_quality: candidate-level released human score aggregated by its official protocol; larger-is-better direction fixed in the dataset manifest
outcomes.primary: held-out decision regret: oracle held-out human quality minus human quality at the selector's pressure, averaged over learned reward checkpoints
outcomes.reporting: Show complete pressure curves and every reward checkpoint, including failed, degenerate, and unreachable runs.
secondary: selected raw and normalized KL pressure

policy.reward_standardization: mean zero and unit variance on the unlabeled optimization pool
policy.scorer: one shared linear vector; no system identity and no bias

pressure.checkpoint_rule: first recorded checkpoint reaching each target; preserve the final checkpoint and mark every unreached target unavailable
pressure.interpretation: zero is uniform and one is maximum concentration
pressure.measure: mean KL(pi || uniform) divided by log(number of available actions), computed on the unlabeled optimization pool
pressure.unreachable_rule: A selector may choose only a target reached by every reward checkpoint being compared in its analysis stratum. No outcome is imputed.

primary_selector.calibration_score: within-segment candidate human scores standardized by the segment standard deviation, then expected under each frozen policy checkpoint and averaged equally over calibration documents
primary_selector.decision_artifact_rule: Write and hash every per-reward pressure decision before evaluation labels are opened.
primary_selector.decision_rule: Among jointly reachable pressure targets, choose the target with the largest mean calibration human-quality change from uniform; ties within exact floating-point equality choose the smaller pressure. The zero-pressure action is always available.
primary_selector.human_feedback: candidate human scores for the frozen calibration segment from each calibration document and train-system candidates only
primary_selector.name: bounded human-calibration pressure argmax

research_question: Can a bounded calibration audit choose a reward-optimization pressure that reduces held-out human-quality decision regret relative to fixed pressure, best-of-N, always-optimize, and always-keep baselines?

reward_models.all_runs_rule: Retain and report every scheduled reward run.
reward_models.external_controls: Freeze exact public checkpoint revisions in the future manifest; report them separately because checkpoints are not reward-training replicates.
reward_models.training_control: Architecture, initialization distribution, optimizer, budget, and score calibration are identical across learned conditions.

secondary_selectors.best_of_n: exact expected calibration human change for uniformly sampled candidate subsets; choose its best prespecified N or keep uniform
secondary_selectors.first_order_sign: completed sign rule applied without modification as a historical baseline
secondary_selectors.pessimistic_calibration: choose the pressure with the largest document-bootstrap lower confidence bound on calibration human change; choose zero unless that bound is positive
